name: AviaX Portugal
blurb: A premium Portuguese full-service airline connecting the world through Lisbon and Porto, with additional gateways in Faro, Funchal and Ponta Delgada.

about: Part of the AVIA X Group, AviaX Portugal is a global full-service airline rooted in Portugal. It is positioned as a premium carrier, offering an elevated travel experience from the lounge to the cabin.
Lisbon and Porto anchor its operation, while Faro, Funchal and Ponta Delgada provide additional connectivity across mainland Portugal, Madeira and the Azores.
network: A mixed fleet of long-haul wide-body aircraft and next-generation narrow-bodies supports an international network spanning every continent.
